name: California Housing
description: A regression dataset derived from the 1990 U.S. Census, containing housing and demographic information for California census block groups. Features include median income, housing age, rooms, bedrooms, population, households, location, and median house value.
citation: Pace, R. K., & Barry, R. (1997). Sparse Spatial Autoregressions. Statistics & Probability Letters, 33(3), 291–297. https://doi.org/10.1016/S0167-7152(96)00140-X
